en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town in a narrow valley, with ornate multi‑story hotels and townhouses lining both sides of a canal-like river. Tree‑lined promenades and colonnade‑type buildings follow the watercourse. Steep, forested hills rise directly behind the town; on the hilltop to the right stands a small lookout tower or pavilion. The architecture is late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century Central European, and one rooftop sign with German text is visible in the foreground.
